name: Robot Money Allocation
thesis_blurb: The four sleeve weights in force on the Robot Money vault, and the assets inside each one. The swarm reviews whether those targets still fit the regime. Whether the vault holds what they say is the vault's subject, not this one.
structural_notes: no portfolio to scrape — the subject IS the allocation.json framework state
the swarm should never default to 'targets are right because they are targets' — reflect on the regime, the research, market conditions, and any item-level read you can support
recommendations cover BOTH the between-bucket mix (95/5/0/0) AND the within-bucket constituents (e.g., inside Conservative DeFi, how should Aave/Compound/Morpho/Sky split?)
the vault subject (robotmoney-vault) reviews how the actual holdings drift from these targets; this subject reviews whether the targets themselves should change
